blocker.summary: R2 target compatibility proof is blocked only by absent cross-compilation toolchains on the macOS host.
blocker.details: The macOS host has no configured Windows MSVC SDK/C header environment: ring invokes cc with --target=x86_64-pc-windows-msvc and fails at fatal error: assert.h file not found; VCINSTALLDIR, CC_x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, and related target compiler variables are unset. cargo check --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu reaches ring and fails because x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc is not installed. No compiler/toolchain installation or substitute was attempted. The R2 source/test subject remains preserved unstaged; all macOS-owned deterministic checks passed and no review, commit, push, or successor dispatch occurred.
blocker.required_authority: Authorize disposable external Windows MSVC and Linux cross-compilation tooling without changing repository source or weakening the target-compile gates, then continue in the same task/worktree.
blocker.handoff_prompt: Preserve this existing worktree byte-for-byte. Do not clean, reset, restore, commit, or publish. Once the platform environment/authority is supplied, resume this same R2 subject under a new explicit continuation binding; reverify base/tree/diff/test/remote, rerun the failed target checks, then complete the remaining deterministic checks, fresh causal review, and publication. R3 was not dispatched.
